description: Taiwan deadlines: annual individual and business income tax return 5/1-5/31 (Income Tax Act art. 71; 2026 extended to 6/1), business tax every two months by the 15th of odd months or monthly for zero-rate applicants (Business Tax Act art. 35; 2026 3/16 and 11/16 computed from weekend shifts, not from a published notice), business income tax prepayment 9/1-9/30 (art. 67); Saturday moves to Monday and Sunday to the next day (Administrative Procedure Act art. 48). Taiwan, as of 2026-11-21 (law.moj.gov.tw and Ministry of Finance). General information and estimates only; no individual tax advice, agency or filing. The 2025 tax year is 114年度, filed in May 2026; national-holiday deadline shifts are not computed, only weekends.
